object.body:
Dear $violationOwnerName,


You are receiving this email because you are designated as a Separation of Duties (SoD) policy violation owner or notification recipient. SoD policy violations have been identified within SailPoint.

Violation Details

Violation Count: $violationCount

Risk Level: $policyLevel

Policy Name: $policyName

Description: $policyDescription

#if($policyExternalReference && $policyExternalReference.trim() != "")

External Reference: $policyExternalReference

#end

If you are designated to manage violations for $policyName, you can do so from the SailPoint Dashboard


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to a user that is designated as an SoD policy violation owner or notification recipient.
object.name: SOD Policy Violation Owner Notification
object.subject: SoD Policy Violations Identified for $policyName
